description:
Use this when the user wants past share prices of an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE over a period, daily, weekly or monthly, for example to chart or compare a move.

Returns end-of-day bars (open, high, low, close, volume) with 50- and 200-day averages. `days` (1 to 1825, default 90) counts calendar days back from today. `interval` is "daily", "weekly" or "monthly"; a daily series longer than 750 bars comes back weekly. `adjusted=true` rescales prices for splits and bonuses; the default is prices as traded. For returns over standard periods use get_returns; for bonds, funds and SME listings, get_security_history.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
